about: Areas scripts/lib/generic-area-name.mjs calls generic that are, on reading, the place's real name. Read by check:generic-area-names; an entry whose name changed is reported as stale.

me_the_general.name: The General
me_the_general.why: a boulder: its siblings under Deadham Railroad are The Captain, The Colonel, The Major and The Private

me_the_general_boulders.name: The General Boulders
me_the_general_boulders.why: the boulder group named for The General (above) — not 'general' as in miscellaneous

ut_a_crags.name: A Crags
ut_a_crags.why: San Rafael Reef's lettered crags, A through N (B Crags = Spotted Wolf Canyon, E Crags = DBC Canyon) — the letter is the name

ut_n_crags.name: N Crags
ut_n_crags.why: San Rafael Reef's lettered crags, A through N — the letter is the name
